series is deliberately "WPT Cyprus Championship 2026 (August)", not the bare "WPT Cyprus Championship": remind.js matches by token-set containment, and the bare name is a subset of "WPT Prime Cyprus Championship" (Oct 15-19, same venue), so this August file would have been served for the October Prime festival too. The extra 2026/August tokens keep the bare tournaments.json spelling matching this file while blocking that false hit.
